scope: public synthetic contract; not a browser extension or live session inventory
goal: Recover work without retaining tabs, model context, or a human courier

session_record.objective: Demonstrate a versioned browser-independent work handoff

invariants: Browser tabs are projections, never the durable work store
An inaccessible chat cannot be represented as recovered
Discovery must distinguish candidates from independently verified work
Close-tab must not delete a durable work record
Every unfinished record retains a trigger or explicit blocker
Only one fenced writer may commit a conflicting work revision
Cross-session acknowledgment requires observed receipt, not quoted conversation
A public manifest must never contain credentials, private mail bodies or chat transcripts without publication authorization
Content hashes and source URLs identify versions; stale snapshots do not supersede newer evidence
migration_gates: Enumerate authorized existing work artifacts without assuming access to every chat
Deduplicate by stable work identity and evidence lineage, not by title similarity
Capture unfinished work, blocked claims and next triggers before closing a session
Read back the persisted record from an independent process
Reopen work in Firefox or another browser without manual context paste
Verify the same work ID, receipt lineage and latest accepted version
Simulate browser crash and worker restart, then verify recovery

browser_policy.firefox: eligible viewing surface; no special authority
browser_policy.edge: eligible viewing surface; removal of tab is not a work deletion
browser_policy.future_cobrowser: optional implementation; must pass same recovery gates

next_qualification: Implement private work inventory and independent reopen test against actual X2 surfaces
